title: broke right away
text: broke right away. The wire on this thing broke on the first try, just halfway through the slice of cheese! I thought since it said "lifetime guarantee" on the package that it'd last at least a little while. Nope. Returning it (bought at Walmart for $6, by the way).

product_metadata.title: Farberware Pro Cheese Slicer, Black
features: Perfect for creating even slices of hard and soft cheeses
description: Farberware's Professional Cheese Slicer is perfect for creating even slices of both hard and soft cheese. It has a comforatable grip handle and is constructed with a durable stainless steel slicing wire, and is dishwasher safe.
